```artifact
Feature: Coordination and Services

  Scenario: VIRTUA-1.3-6 - Coordinate software engineering activities
    Given the system is configured for software engineering process
    When an activity is initiated
    Then the system coordinates the activity

  Scenario: VIRTUA-1.3-7 - Guidance by Prof. Chandrasekaran and staff
    Given Prof. Chandrasekaran and other staff are registered as mentors
    When a user requests guidance
    Then the system provides guidance from Prof. Chandrasekaran or other staff

  Scenario Outline: VIRTUA-1.4-1 - Display authorized chemists in zone at discounted prices
    Given the user searches for medicines in zone "<zone>"
    When the search is submitted
    Then the system displays authorized chemists within the zone
    And the system displays medicines at discounted prices

    Examples:
      | zone       | description        |
      | Zone A     | normal zone        |
      | Z          | edge: single char  |
      |            | invalid: empty     |

  Scenario: VIRTUA-1.4-2 - Door-step laboratory services via specimen collection
    Given the user requests door-step laboratory service
    When the system checks service availability
    Then the system provides door-step laboratory service
    And the system schedules specimen collection
```
